title: Off-host copy of the backup
goal: Each backup is copied to the chosen destination
acceptance: After each backup the copy is sent to the destination chosen in F-026-T03; a failed copy raises a hub alert and the next run retries
A test with a fake destination covers success and failure
Failing test committed first: the failed-destination case expects an alert against the current scheduler; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Depends on the chosen destination; size assumes a simple file copy or upload. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
